constraint_policy.physical_rules: tcprtt = synack + ackdat; TCP-only fields are 0 for non-TCP flows; smean = round(sbytes / spkts); dmean = round(dbytes / dpkts), 0 if dpkts = 0; rate = (spkts + dpkts - 1) / dur (0 if dur = 0), within 1%; sload = (sbytes - smean) * 8 / dur, within 1%; dload = (dbytes - dmean) * 8 / dur, within 1%; sloss <= spkts; dloss <= dpkts; spkts >= 1; sbytes >= 28 * spkts (observed bound, not a protocol rule)

excluded.ackdat: excluded until its dependencies are verified
excluded.dur: excluded: sinpkt/sjit cannot be repaired (sinpkt = 1000*dur/(spkts-1) holds for 74.7% of sub-train rows)
excluded.sloss: excluded until its dependencies are verified
excluded.stcpb: excluded until its dependencies are verified
excluded.sttl: excluded: alternative (state, sttl, dttl) combinations have too little support (1 and 8 rows)
excluded.swin: excluded until its dependencies are verified

unverified_for_edit.spkts: sinpkt/sjit (mean inter-packet time and jitter) depend on spkts and dur; sinpkt = 1000*dur/(spkts-1) holds for only 74.7% of sub-train rows, so they stay unchanged

datasets.note: role assigned by row count; the file names in data/raw are swapped relative to their roles

pre_run.note: Written before any Step 6 v2 experiment. It records the starting state (code, data, models, protocol); it contains no results.

constraint_policy.enforced: per task: current_v1 or physical_v1 (see constraint_policy_definitions)

constraint_policy_definitions.current_v1: src/unsw/constraints.py validate_candidate + budget A/B (the v1 policy, unchanged)
constraint_policy_definitions.physical_v1: src/unsw/physical_repair.py: sbytes and spkts only, increase only, 1% value lattice shared by targeted and random search, derived features smean/rate/sload (and dmean/dload/tcprtt) repaired, every candidate re-checked; dur, sttl, sloss, swin, stcpb, ackdat and all timing features excluded

exhaustive_evaluation.candidates: every valid physical_v1 lattice candidate of every sample and budget that the model still predicts as attack
exhaustive_evaluation.deduplication: one LIME evaluation per unique (model, sample, candidate feature values, seed); identities (model, sample, budget, policy, candidate) are kept in the results
exhaustive_evaluation.reporting: candidates consistent_with_checked_rules reported separately from candidates with unverified_dependencies
exhaustive_evaluation.scope: definitive only for the enumerated physical_v1 lattice, not for every possible network modification

protocol.explanation_budget_semantics: actual LIME explanation calls per method per configuration, the baseline explanation(s) of the original sample included

heldout_metrics.primary: heldout_top10_jaccard_mean and heldout_spearman_mean over heldout_lime_seeds, each compared with the original's held-out seed-pair minimum

models_pending_approval.note: need new validation pipelines (training approval, decision D12) and a protocol amendment before any run

objective.reference: original sample explanation under the same LIME seed

protocol.official_test_set: locked: never used by any v2 run; at most one predeclared final evaluation (decision D10), outside this protocol

physical_report.implementation: src.unsw.physical_repair.physical_report (physical_report_v2), used by every v2 run instead of the v1 classification
physical_report.note: no candidate is ever called physically valid; unverified packet-timing dependencies are reported separately

protocol.prefix_shortcut_rule: a method with prefix_shortcut=true is run once at the largest explanation budget and its 25/50 results are read from checkpoints; methods with false are run separately at every budget

primary_analysis.P1: spoofing success counts (candidates and samples meeting the LIME success criterion), per model x perturbation budget x LIME budget x policy, with exact 95% intervals at the sample level
primary_analysis.P2: shuffled greedy vs matched random control, physical_v1, single_seed objective, 100 LIME calls; metric: held-out Spearman shift (1 - mean rho over seeds 22/33/44/55), per-sample means of 10 runs each; Wilcoxon signed-rank, two-sided, over the 10 samples; family of 4 tests (RF/XGB x budget A/B), Holm-corrected, alpha 0.05. Unchanged; reported together with search coverage of the legal lattice and early stopping.

protocol.sample_selection_rule: from the 20-sample shared manifest: all 5 TCP sessions plus 5 short flows covering every attack type, keeping the 3 v1 samples (2941, 3206, 4407); chosen by flow type and attack category only

multi_seed_k3.aggregation: mean of the objective over the three seeds; the original is explained once per seed; every candidate costs 3 LIME calls

single_seed.aggregation: objective at the search seed (v1 objective)

protocol.status: predeclared before any Step 6 v2 run (decisions: docs/step6_v2_decisions.md); do not edit after v2 results exist. Step 6 v1 (experiments/step6_protocol.json) stays unchanged.

random_control.matched: same model, sample, perturbation budget, constraint policy, legal-move lattice, objective and LIME budget as the targeted runs

success_criteria.lime: still attack (P >= 0.5) AND passes the enforced policy AND held-out top-10 Jaccard AND Spearman both below the sample's held-out seed-pair minimum AND (under physical_v1) physical status consistent_with_checked_rules
reported_always: P(attack) original and candidate, delta P
repaired derived features and relative changes
success_criteria.shap: decision D11 (fixed before any SHAP experiment); not part of this protocol's runs yet
